fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Mbeki and I live at 343 Alder Close, Madison, WI 53769. You can reach me on (555) 444-2982 or dmitri.mbeki@example.com. A delivery driver slipped on our icy front steps on 29 June 2024 and was taken to hospital. They have said they will make a claim against us. Policy HH-2024-00141. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Mbeki on (555) 444-2982 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 29 June 2024.
Site visit to 343 Alder Close. Neighbour Samuel Petrov was present and confirmed the timeline.
Injured party Chloe Ferreira sustained a broken collarbone and was treated at Mercy General. Do not admit liability; refer.
